scope: Conditional finite single-bounce E/pi consistency after separate raster-aware input qualification; not default multi-bounce certification.

sceneClosure.note: GPU readback completion closes the selected command boundary; CPU status text alone does not prove completion.
sceneClosure.lightSelection: One authored enabled directional light and lightSelected=1; spatial selector is disabled and its capacity-omitted diagnostic is the -1 sentinel.
sceneClosure.authoredOnlyFields: WorkflowMode=1, smoothness=0, disabled keywords and zero ambient/reflection are fixed in the hash-matched temporary harness source, not separate receipt fields.
sceneClosure.cameraAspect: Pre-target scene aspect is informational. Actual gather VP/invVP and dimensions define sample geometry.

inputQualification.scope: Input consistency only. Neither product RGB nor finite radiance limits enter this qualification.
inputQualification.clipping: For a planar depth field, any clipped vertex is on the same depth plane. Convex barycentric interpolation bounds snapping by (abs(a)+abs(b))*0.6/256.
inputQualification.precisionScope: The source interval models normative raster-coordinate snapping plus float32 outward storage. It is an input consistency check, not an exhaustive bound on all permitted forward projection/clipping implementation errors.
inputQualification.reconstruction: Exact rational interval endpoints; each float32 operation is rounded outward with an additional one-ULP allowance.
